
Besides the content of Tiki pages themselves, there are also lots of little words used in the Tiki interface that you might want to translate.

You may first want to [[jbocre: ailto:lojban-www@lojban.org ail the webmasters]] to ask them to make sure they've imported the latest data for your language.

Having done so, go to the box named Menu, Admin -> Edit languages.  In the second half of the box, select [http://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/IG/ert/iso639.htm our language's code], "Translate recorded" and set.  Then just walk the list translating things.

Sometimes things take a while to show up.  If you'd like them to show up faster, your best bet is to come to [[Lojban IRC he IRC channel|Lojban IRC he IRC channel]] and ask rlpowell to clear the Tiki cache.
